subject.title: Android: add adaptive app navigation sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw’s Android shell adopt this Material 3 adaptive navigation redesign, including moving the existing rich sidebar into a secondary modal drawer, as the supported navigation model?
rationale: This is a large user-visible navigation and accessibility redesign rather than a narrowly established bug fix; implementation quality cannot establish the desired permanent Android interaction model by itself.

options.title: Sponsor the Material adaptive navigation direction
options.body: Have an Android owner confirm the navigation model, then require clean current-head validation and direct current-head behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Retain the existing shell architecture and submit only a focused, separately justified fix for any confirmed compact-label or reachability defect.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the Android product direction is not currently intended, preserving the discussion as design context.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Material adaptive navigation direction
recommendation.body: Have an Android owner confirm the navigation model, then require clean current-head validation and direct current-head behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent branch follow-up commits show direct familiarity with the final Android navigation and gateway-status changes, although current-main Android ownership was not independently verifiable.
